Hello everyone, we kindly invite you to the 12th Architectural Exhibition, "First Step Towards Architecture," which is organized by the first-semester students (Design I, Batch 231). The exhibition will commence on June 11, 2023, at 10 a.m. in the sky gallery, department of architecture of North South University. The student's work will be on exhibition until June 13th, 2023. The exhibition will feature the work of ARC111, ARC112, ARC123, & ARC131. Your participation at the event would be a huge source of inspiration and motivation for the participants.
(Poster & Invitation Card done by Batch 231) See less

Dear respected Faculties, Alumnus and Seniors,
We are delighted to inform you that we, the students of ARC 111, will be hosting the 9th  Architectural Exhibition of “First Step Towards Architecture”. The event will be held in the exhibition gallery of North South University. The exhibition will display the works of ARC111, ARC112, ARC123, ARC131, ARC213 and ARC273.
We highly appreciate your presence at the opening on the 10th of May at 10am. Our works will remain on display till the 18th, everyday from 10am till 6pm, where we impatiently wait to share our hands-on experiences at our first step towards architecture.
Your presence would only encourage us to work harder and improve our qualities as a future architect! Kindly refer to the invitation cards and poster attached to this post.
Regards,
Tanim Ibn Alam 
On behalf of ARC 111
